svg.title: Gold Coast coast-to-range planning schematic
svg.desc: A not-to-scale planning instrument. A solid station spine lists the Translink L1 corridor from Helensvale through Surfers Paradise and Broadbeach to Burleigh Heads. Separate dashed boxes describe an independently planned southern coast visit to Coolangatta and a separate road or operator choice for Springbrook or Lamington. No geographic positions, routes, distances, bearings, timetables or service guarantees are shown. The key is in five languages. Project original; no separate reuse license declared. Commercial reuse eligibility unknown.
svg.text: AUSTRALIA FIELD ATLAS · QUEENSLAND
One tram spine; two separate travel plans.
A trip-selection instrument, not a geographic map, navigation aid or timetable.
TRANSLINK L1 · LISTED STATION ORDER · VERIFY THE TRAVEL-DATE SERVICE
Choose the stop for the actual hotel, beach access or venue; the spacing below carries no geographic meaning.

FIVE-LANGUAGE KEY · SOLID IS THE LISTED STATION ORDER; DASHED BOXES MEAN A SEPARATE PLAN
EN · L1 stations are shown in listed order, not to scale. Dashed boxes need a separate trip plan. No distance, route shape, timetable or service is guaranteed.
繁中・L1 車站依目前列示順序排列，非比例。虛線框代表須另行規劃的行程。不標示距離、路線形狀或時刻表，也不保證交通服務。
日本語・L1の駅は掲載順に表示（縮尺なし）。破線枠は別途計画する行程です。距離、路線形状、時刻表、運行は示さず保証しません。
한국어 · L1 역은 표시된 순서이며 축척과 무관합니다. 점선 상자는 별도 계획이 필요한 여정입니다. 거리, 실제 노선 형태, 시간표 또는 운행을 보장하지 않습니다.
ไทย · สถานี L1 เรียงตามลำดับที่แสดง ไม่เป็นมาตราส่วน กรอบเส้นประคือทริปที่ต้องวางแผนแยก ไม่รับประกันระยะทาง รูปแบบเส้นทาง ตารางเวลา หรือบริการ
Check the current Translink planner, park alerts, Beachsafe advice and weather before each leg.
No geographic position, direction, distance, scheduled transfer or access guarantee is represented.
